section: Science (Paper-2) · Ch — Natural Resources & Conservation — Deep 2
subject: Science
stem: Development that meets the needs of the present generation without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs is called:
explanation: Sustainable development balances current developmental needs against long-term ecological and resource preservation, ensuring resources remain available for future generations — a guiding principle of modern environmental policy.

stem: Reducing the use of a resource, using it again for the same or a different purpose, and processing waste material to make new products are collectively summarised by the '3 Rs' of conservation:
explanation: Reduce (use less), Reuse (use again), Recycle (process waste into new products) are the standard '3 Rs' framework taught for resource conservation and waste management.
